name: triposr
license: MIT (free for personal and commercial use)

resources.meshSecondsTypical: ~0.5-1.5s per mesh on consumer GPU; ~15-30s on CPU

notes: Single-image feed-forward 3D reconstruction. Takes one image (any angle of any object), produces a textured 3D mesh in under a second on a consumer GPU. Output meshes have vertex colors only, not PBR materials — for production game/AR assets that need albedo/normal/roughness/metallic maps, use Hunyuan3D 2.1 instead (separate runner, post-1.0). MIT license means commercial use is unrestricted. Background removal via rembg is on by default; turn off with removeBackground:false if your input is already cleanly composited.
